description: Issue posted by an account posing as a platform security bot tells maintainers to pipe a script from a raw IP into sudo bash within 24 hours or lose the repository.
rationale: Impersonated authority, deadline threat and a root-level remote script from an IP address; a real platform would not ask maintainers to run an unsigned script this way.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
